reviews.text: I went for the first time with my dog, who is a little timid, and the treatment she received was spectacular in terms of patience and care. We definitely have a veterinarian we can trust now.

I have nothing but praise for this clinic and its professionals. They have always treated all my furry friends with incredible care. You can tell they love their work. I've been going there for over a decade with my dog, my cats, and animals I've rescued from the street. I read comments that I find shameful... so I've come here to give my opinion after 10 years of visits and experiences. I would recommend them without a second thought. A big hug from me and your furry patients: Thor, Tyrion, Yuumi, and Hades ❤️

Laura was a true professional, with a special touch when trimming and brushing my cat's nails. It was incredible what she managed to do with a cat who is usually very timid. I'm so grateful. I highly recommend her!

This clinic isn't what it used to be. The care and friendliness have declined drastically. I don't feel they take previous checkups into account for better follow-up with my dog. They keep changing vets, and if you're not paying attention, they put you in with the new one without asking, and of course, she doesn't know your dog or his issues. I no longer trust them because the checkups seem very superficial, and when there's a problem, they don't offer solutions or acknowledge anything.
The vet provided good service, although the wait time was excessive. I understand they have to follow a schedule, but I've never had to wait two hours for that before. Something to consider ;)

Thank you so much for your feedback, Patry.

We're delighted to hear that your experience at the clinic was positive. We will continue working every day to provide the best possible care to both our patients and their families.

Thank you for trusting us!

My recent experience at La Llum veterinary clinic was very unpleasant, especially compared to a previous visit.

Today I took my 17-year-old cat for a simple blood test. The veterinarian insisted that sedation was mandatory, claiming it was "for the safety of the staff," and also indicated that the owner had to leave the room during the procedure. For such an old animal, and for such a simple test, this requirement was particularly harsh and difficult for me to accept.

I was also told that if I didn't agree to these conditions, I should go to another clinic. This form of communication made me very uncomfortable, and I didn't feel that I was offered any alternative as the owner.

Later, I went to another veterinary clinic, where the treatment was very friendly, and the blood draw was performed without sedation and without any problems. This made me doubt that sedation and the owner's separation were really necessary in this case.

Furthermore, at this visit, I was charged €45 for a consultation, while at the other clinic, I only paid for the blood test.

I would like to add that I had already visited this same clinic in 2023, and at that time the consultation cost €28. On that occasion, I was seen by a young veterinarian who was very friendly and professional, and the examination was very thorough, so the experience was positive.

I have the impression that the change in the experience might be related to a change of veterinarian, since on this last visit the treatment was much more rigid and lacked empathy.

Based on my personal experience, I would not choose this clinic again nor would I recommend it, especially for owners of senior pets.

Thank you for everything. I'm Lars's owner. He was sick and his quality of life was very poor. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your attention during this difficult decision. Talking to the vet comforted me, and I know his passing was for the best. You did everything possible for him, and those of us who have pets really appreciate that. Always attentive, always giving the best care, and always there when it mattered most. You do everything possible and more for your pet, and if you can't give him a dignified end, thank you so much for everything you did. 😘

Thank you so much for your review! 🐾✨
We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience.
We'll always be here for you. Hugs! …
Exceptional and very friendly service from the entire team. My dog ​​and cat are delighted every time they go. Highly recommended!

They are excellent professionals, very caring with the animals we bring in for treatment. They treat them very well. I've been going to them for many years and have no complaints. I currently have two six-month-old kittens and an eleven-year-old dog. I had a dog that we had to have put down in 2018, and they treated us with great compassion. I thank them for everything. In fact, when I take my dog ​​out, he takes me right to the vet's door; he loves going there. And my son, who also has a cat and a dog, takes them there too.
Good prices and excellent service from the receptionist, I would definitely return
I received excellent service.

It's always a great experience. I've been taking my older dog there for years, and now that I have my other dog, I take them there without hesitation. The care is exceptional, and the treatment of both the animals and the owners is unbeatable. I definitely recommend this clinic.
They treated Sam with great care. They were very attentive to his injury, following up with him after the consultation. Their love for animals is evident.
Professional and very friendly service. Thank you!

I'm so happy with La Llum Veterinary Clinic. My dog ​​Jocker has been a patient there for years, and he recently had to undergo a rather complicated surgery. Thanks to the professionalism and kindness of the doctors, everything went perfectly. The operation and aftercare were impeccable, and even though Jocker isn't an easy patient, they always treat him with so much patience and care. I couldn't be more grateful. Highly recommended! 🤩🤩🤩🔝
Very good experience, I'm happy with the service. I always go there to buy food for my dogs and they treat me well.

I just took my cat for his annual vaccination. The vet who saw him wasn't the same one he had before, which isn't the main issue, but I felt the treatment and service were inadequate. Despite the vaccine price going up again, the consultation was even worse. To begin with, the vet came into the examination room speaking very loudly and showing absolutely no empathy for an animal that was frozen with fear. She didn't even do a basic examination; she only looked at his mouth and ears. She didn't listen to his heart and lungs. They didn't weigh him; I had to ask them to. For the price of the vaccine, the least she could do is examine him properly and with empathy.
Excellent care, accurate diagnosis helped my dog ​​recover very quickly.

We found them because we needed to spay our dog Perla. A neighbor recommended them, and honestly... it was the best decision. We're thrilled; they're wonderful. You can tell they love animals so much. They treat them with the utmost care, pampering them immensely, and most importantly... they make sure our furry friends aren't afraid of going to the vet. On the contrary, they go in wagging their tails! 😊 They're all very professional and so charming! It had been years since we'd found vets like them. In fact, we're going to switch to them. Our dog Perla is overjoyed, and seeing her like this gives us even more confidence.

By the way, the surgeon who operated on her did an excellent job. I've attached a photo from the day of the surgery, back home. 🥰🫂🐕❤️
We couldn't be happier, thank you for everything

My experience at this clinic has been incredibly positive. The staff are fantastic, from the doctors to the receptionists and assistants. The treatment and service are spectacular. I am so grateful for the patience and excellent work you have shown me and my cat, Coco, over the years. When I return to Valencia, I will definitely pay you a visit. Keep up the great work! Hugs 🩷😸

Awful. My dog ​​was misdiagnosed and received incorrect treatment that worsened her condition. I wouldn't go back for anything in the world. They should close it down; it would be a favor to our wallets and our animals. Thank you!

I appreciate the attention I received yesterday; they saw me without an appointment. That was a really nice touch. The service, as always, from both Laura and the receptionist, was fantastic. Now we just have to wait and see if the antibiotics they prescribed take effect. The price seemed reasonable, it's just that they take a while to charge, haha.
Excellent service, the receptionist was lovely!
Laura is one of the few honest veterinarians; she has a passion for animals.
Silvana was very attentive and professional.
We've been taking my dog ​​Tolkien to this clinic for years and we couldn't be happier. They provide excellent service and are incredibly kind. 100000000% recommended!

For years I took my cat to this clinic and trusted that he was receiving all the necessary vaccinations. I even specifically asked if everything was up to date so I could take him to the river, and they said yes. Now, having changed vets, I've discovered that he was never vaccinated against rabies, nor was I informed of its importance. I'm very disappointed because, although my cat is healthy, anything could have happened to him. I wouldn't recommend this clinic to anyone who wants to be truly informed about their pet's health.
The way they treat Anubis and Venus is spectacular; I'm so happy with the attention they give to both our pets and us. 10/10

A terrible experience. I took my cat in, and in five minutes they told me he had a fungal infection, gave me some ointment, and that was it. They charged me 50 euros, but it turns out the ointment caused an allergic reaction in my cat, almost resulting in severe poisoning. I took him back five days later, and as if they were doing me a favor, they took him in and told me the cat was allergic. I couldn't have seen that the first time. What kind of vets are they? Then they told me they had to do blood work. I couldn't have thought of that the first time I took him. The fact is, my cat was vomiting. They took my money and ruined my cat's health, and then, with all that "Fraga" nonsense, she goes and says the cat is allergic to the ointment she herself prescribed. I mean, what kind of vets are they? You get a different one every time, and on top of that, they don't give a receipt. Is it so you can't complain, or are they making money under the table? If I catch that vet, I'll ruin her, just like she did to my cat.

The worst of the worst.
All they know how to do is charge for unnecessary tests. Don't waste your time and go to Aitana in Mislata; they're real professionals, not money-grubbers.

Reply to the reply: You already apologized to me in person, but besides letting the animal suffer, you made my family suffer, and I won't forgive you for that. All for the money. Animal protection law? No, making money by running tests on a dying 17-year-old dog.

We are very happy with them. My daughter takes my dog, #Akira, there, and she comes out very calm. She also takes care of my son's dog, #Peca, who lives in Chelva and is my dog's sister. Both of them go to Llum. Auntie is the one who goes. It was recommended to us, and we recommend them too. AKIRA and PECA wish you a happy 2025!
They have always treated Luna magnificently.

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! 🌟

Your trust means a lot to us. We're here for you whenever you need us! 🐾✨ …
They are the best, they always take care of and treat my dog ​​as if he were their own
A professional team and you can tell how much they care for our pets.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We're delighted to hear you had a positive experience at our clinic. We look forward to seeing you again!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! It's always a joy to have Bull and you at the clinic. Hugs, see you soon! 🐾❤️ …
